finding.summary: The current activity cue is a single, fast pass over only the first seven working nodes, while the canonical snapshot contains thirteen working nodes.
finding.impact: Six working agents receive no pulse cue, and the 0.12 s expand plus 0.12 s restore per node makes the state signal difficult to read at the rendered 15 fps cadence.
finding.scope: Visual behavior only; idle-state rendering and source privacy boundary remain unchanged.

candidate_change.intent: Make working state legible as a bounded, repeated activity signal without implying hidden reasoning or changing source data.
candidate_change.proposed_change: In the pulse block, retain the existing status gate (`if working: pulses.append(node)`) and replace the one-shot `for node in pulses[:7]` sequence with two deterministic, staggered cycles over all `pulses`. Use a modest scale/opacity excursion (for example scale 1.22 and opacity 0.70, restored to scale 1.0 and opacity 0.92), with each phase long enough to occupy at least 4 frames at 15 fps and with a fixed lag between nodes.
guardrails: Never include idle nodes in the pulse list.
Do not add agent-specific text, task content, reasoning, credentials, or other non-canonical data.
Keep the change confined to the working-state pulse timing/coverage block.
acceptance: All 13 canonical working nodes show the same deterministic pulse pattern.
The 2 canonical idle nodes remain visually idle throughout the pulse interval.
The pulse is readable at 854x480, 15 fps without obscuring labels or receipt/task-parcel cues.

evidence.observed: A node is appended to pulses only when agent status equals working; idle nodes are excluded by construction.
The current loop iterates over pulses[:7] and gives each selected node 0.12 s expand plus 0.12 s restore, for 1.68 s total pulse animation.

falsifier: After a QA-only rerender, if fewer than 13 working-node ROIs show two pulse peaks, if either idle-node ROI changes during the pulse window, or if the pulse cannot be distinguished at 15 fps without label occlusion, reject this candidate.

next_measurement.render_target: A new QA-only 480p15 artifact; do not overwrite production media or scene files.
procedure: Render the proposal in an isolated output directory using the same canonical snapshot.
Use ffprobe to verify 854x480 and 15 fps, then sample the pulse window frame-by-frame.
Measure luminance/area changes in the 13 working-node ROIs and the 2 idle-node ROIs; require two peaks per working ROI and no threshold-crossing change in idle ROIs.
Have a visual QA pass confirm labels, task parcels, receipt, and footer remain readable.
